text.p: A young Russian army conscript shot dead three fellow soldiers and a civilian on Saturday, claiming afterwards he lost his head after persistent bullying, police said.

A police spokesman in the Urals city of Perm said Private Oleg Lokhmatov was detained after turning his gun on other members of his guard detail around 2 p.m. (0900 GMT) and then running amok in a shop, killing a customer and wounding a salesman.

Lokhmatov, who was called up in June, was the latest in a series of Russian soldiers to resort to violence against colleagues over alleged bullying. Conditions in the army have deteriorated dramatically since the collapse of the Soviet Union, leaving servicemen often unpaid, ill-clad and hungry.
